page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top right, with the page number at top left. A marginal note "fol.306." in the left margin beside the line "perstitiosi". Catchword "preci-" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: cautionis causa creditori syngraphas, quas secum e vita discedens deferat ad inferos: claro denique eos ut plurimum esse genere, eo quòd Japonii proceres multiplici prole onerati, quibus filiis satis amplum patrimonium relinquere se posse diffidunt, hos fere ad Bontiorum numerum aggregēt. Christianos hosce diceres monachos, vel,si mores spectes, Canonicos, & Romanæ Ecclesiæ prælatos, si lux Evangelii vel tenuiter eis ante nostrorum hominum ad ipsos adventu affulsisset: vel ullus omnino ad illos Christianus, ex quo hæc audita imitarentur, penetrasset. Sed neq; animarum cultus Japoniis deest, in quo tamen paulo magis, quàm nos, sunt superstitiosi.fol.306.Nā Augusto mense integrum ipsi biduum tribuere dicuntur colendis manib,mortuorum. Sub imminentem noctem in ædiū foribus lampadas multas accedere, vario genere pictu-ræ & ornatu: inde urbem nocte tota partim religionis, partim spectandi causa perambulare: magnam etiam populi vim, cum advesperascit, ex urbe, adventantibus suorum (ut ipsi videlicet opinantur) manibus obviam prodire. Ubi quædam ad locum perventum est, quo loco eos sibi occurrere arbitrantur, humanis primum verbis excipere: Felix, dicentes, faustuq;[?] sit vester adventus, jamdiu aspectus vestri fructu carui-mus: confidete parumper, ciboq; vos ex itine-ris defatigatione reficite. page.notes: Doubtful readings: "vel,si" (the s is hard to read, so it is marked as "si" without a mark, but "vel,li" could be meant); "faustuq;" is marked [?]; "confidete" may be a misprint for "considete" but is copied as printed. The printed "Nā Augusto" has no space between "Nā" and "Augusto" in the scan; a space has been added. "manib,mortuorum" is printed with a comma and no space. Long s and u/v have been normalised as instructed. The "fol.306." marginal note sits in the left margin at the "perstitiosi" line.
